title: Occurrence, distribution and risk assessment of organic micropollutants in the Saronikos Gulf, Greece, utilizing LC-TIMS-HRMS
content:
Environ. Sci.: Adv., 2026, 5,416-434
DOI: 10.1039/D5VA00287G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Rallis Lougkovois, Constantine Parinos, Georgios Gkotsis, Maria-Christina Nika, Ioannis Hatzianestis, Alexandra Pavlidou, Nikolaos Thomaidis
The pollution status of Saronikos Gulf was studied via target and suspect screening, with WWTPs identified as the main sources. PFAS concentrations exceeded AA-EQS values in 92% of seawater samples. Circulation/precipitation patterns are discussed.
